title: Trajectory analysis of sleep disorders and anxiety-depression in female breast cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy: based on group-based Multi-Trajectory Model and machine learning.
summary: In 150 breast-cancer patients followed through four chemotherapy cycles, a group-based multi-trajectory model identified stable (74.7%) and deteriorating (25.3%) sleep and anxiety-depression symptom groups. LASSO-selected predictors fed seven machine-learning models assessing factors associated with the deteriorating group; the selected Naive Bayes model had test AUC 0.863, accuracy 0.839 and a Brier score of 0.132. The associations are not causal, and independent replication and prospective real-world benefit are not established.
ai_technology: LASSO selected predictors for seven compared machine-learning models that classified symptom-trajectory groups in a prospective chemotherapy cohort; the group-based multi-trajectory model itself was statistical.
